headline: Netanyahu and Zamir Clash Over Iran Operation as Strikes Rock Provinces
subheadline: Multiple massive explosions hit coastal Hormozgan and a launcher was struck in Sirik, while CENTCOM plans expanded targets including Iranian energy infrastructure.
lede: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and IDF Chief of Staff Zamir clashed in an unprecedented dispute over a pending high-risk operation that could trigger war with Iran, as Zamir demanded full discussion and legal sign-off. The friction comes as Iran experiences a series of unexplained kinetic events, including a missile launch toward the Strait of Hormuz, massive coastal explosions in Hormozgan, a launcher strike in Sirik, and a blast in Ahvaz, Khuzestan. Meanwhile, US officials warned of potential Iranian assassination plots against American ambassadors and officials, with CENTCOM planning expanded bombing targets against Iranian energy infrastructure.

sections.title: Ukrainian Strikes Target Russian Defense Industrial Bases
sections.body: Russia conducted a massive combined arms barrage this week, launching approximately 1,600 guided aerial bombs, 48 missiles, and nearly 2,300 drones against Ukrainian energy and civilian infrastructure across nine regions. Ukrainian drones struck critical Russian defense industrial nodes deep inside Russia, hitting the Energiya battery plant in Yelets and the AVISMA titanium alloy plant in Berezniki. On the ground, Russian forces advanced near Kostiantynivka and Vozdvyzhivka in Donetsk Oblast, while a Russian drone strike on a residential building in Vinnytsia injured six civilians. Ukrainian forces also delivered four tons of food, medicine, and toys via drone to the occupied city of Oleshky in Kherson Oblast.

sections.title: Middle East Fractures Amid Iran Kinetic Strikes
sections.body: Iran experienced a series of kinetic events, including a missile launch from Kuhestak toward the Strait of Hormuz, multiple explosions in coastal Hormozgan, a launcher strike in Sirik, and a blast in Ahvaz. Israeli command structures are fractured as Netanyahu and IDF Chief Zamir clash over a pending operation risking war with Iran, while Netanyahu publicly warned of disproportionate strikes against Iranian election interference. Hezbollah maintained persistent armed drone operations over Beirut and helicopter movements toward northern Israel, as West Bank violence persisted with a fatal checkpoint attack. US officials warned that Iran may seek to kill US ambassadors and American officials, while a Saudi Hercules transport plane landed at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous occurrence of unexplained kinetic events inside Iran and the deep fracture in Israeli leadership over a pending high-risk operation suggests a highly volatile escalation ladder, where internal discord could coincide with external provocation or rapid retaliation. The US warning of potential Iranian assassination plots against diplomats, combined with CENTCOM's expanded target planning against Iranian energy infrastructure, indicates that the confrontation envelope is rapidly broadening to direct state-on-state conflict. In Ukraine, the mutual striking of critical defense industrial nodes demonstrates a clear shift toward targeting strategic supply chains deep inside adversary territory.
